tools.name: latest_items
tools.description: The newest published entries of the Emergent.FM agent feed, newest first: the daily show's items, the site's stories and wire rows, each with a trust label and a source link. A story carries its topic; filter by kind or topic.

tools.name: items_by_date
tools.description: Every published entry of one day (New York time): that day's show items, its newsroom stories and its wire rows. Covers the feed's last 30 shows, six weeks of stories and at most 500 wire rows.

tools.name: search_items
tools.description: Published entries filtered by tool, vendor, change type, a story's topic and words in the text, newest first. Searches one read of at most 500 entries, made of the last 30 shows and the newest wire rows.

tools.name: get_article
tools.description: One published article as Markdown: its canonical address, feed id, publish and modified dates, any correction, key points, sections, updates and linked sources. Takes a feed entry's _emergent_fm.article_id (a story id like "story-6", a change id like "change-12" or a guide id like "guide-openai-batc

tools.name: get_item
tools.description: One published entry by id, like "item-45", "story-6" or "wire-123". An id that is not published, or a deleted story, is not found.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_article · Public sink: get_article · Destructive: get_article.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_article · Public sink: get_article · Destructive: get_article

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
